402020101.text: Alright, the mechanisms have been activated.

402020102.text: Now, all we have to do is wait for our target to take the bait...

402020103.text: You know what? For some strange reason, Paimon's not nervous at all.

402020104.text: My dear Monsieur Diderot... Here to make excuses for your complete failure at the auction, or to fish for a bigger cut?

402020105.text: Accidents happen, of course. What I care about, is whether you have the spine to deal with the consequences...

402020106.text: So, you do believe in consequences... Seems a bit ironic coming from the likes of you.

402020108.text: A trap, I presume? I've set a fair share of those myself. I suppose it's about time I stumbled into one set by someone else...

402020109.text: No matter. Sometimes you take a chance on someone who turns out to be a disappointment... It's happened before.

402020110.text: It's not easy to earn the Dark Financier Rovere Pellicia's respect, but I must say, you three detectives are a force to be reckoned with. I suppose congratulations are in order...

402020111.text: Six months of planning and execution was all it took to take down a Mora-laundering organization decades in the making. I have to hand it to the Fontaine and Liyue authorities — your operation really has been a roaring success!

402020112.text: Why is the Dark Financier so... polite? Not the kind of crime boss Paimon was expecting!

402020115.text: Oh, do be serious. You thought you'd corner me, and then what? I'd just surrender?

402020116.text: If you want to do this the easy way, then yes. You know you're out of options.

402020117.text: For two months, I've watched you and Officer Edler dismantle my organization piece by piece.

402020118.text: As you cut off my limbs, gouged out my eyes, deafened my ears... I was helpless to stop it.

402020119.text: So you're planning on taking us down with you, is that it? Heh, never heard that one before...

402020120.text: My livelihood is in tatters, Agent Yelan. Hundreds I had working under me, hundreds — and now, they're either locked up or useless. Corder is the only one who still has some value...

402020121.text: My Mora-laundering days are over, we both know that. And considering how your operation's been progressing, it was only a matter of time before you locked onto me.

402020122.text: I'm usually one to quit while I'm ahead, but you see, there's only so much a man can lose before he starts to get rather... angry.

402020123.text: So, Agent Yelan, even if the only score I get to settle here today is ending your precious life — well, that's a high I'll ride straight to the bank!

402020124.text: Ah, clockwork meka! Paimon takes back what she said! This isn't very polite at all!

402020125.text: An old military model. Bet these go for big bucks on the black market...

402020126.text: You two have been a huge help. But this fight is mine.

402020127.text: Cause as it so happens, he isn't the only one who has a score to settle here. If he wants to bring on the drama, then I'm more than happy to give him a show.

402020201.text: Good evening, patrons. Allow me to escort you to the auction.

402020202.text: Oooh... Paimon's getting a little nervous, but we gotta keep it together! This is our best chance to catch these guys!

402020401.text: W—Wow, this place is packed... Is every rich person in Fontaine here or something...?

402020402.text: Oh, wait, the people we're after are hiding here too. It's time to get serious! Paimon knows just the thing!

402020404.text: What! It's not like we're rich like the rest of these people. We need a little something to blend in! Besides, if we're here as honest, hardworking detectives, we might as well look the part!

402020408.text: Paimon doesn't have another. But, she'll help you make one once this is all over! An even cooler pair!

402020409.text: Well, you two seem raring to go. Good to see you're not nervous.

402020410.text: But remember — the key to blending into an event like this is remaining calm and collected. Slow your breathing, tone down the emotion... We don't want to stand out.

402020412.text: It is you, right? It must be you!

subQuests.subQuestName: Equip the item and begin your investigation

402021601.text: (The time is right. I should start investigating.)

402020301.text: Wow! I can't believe I won the bid for this antique painted vase! Should be a wonderful addition to my home decor!

402020302.text: Did you see those tea sets from Chenyu Vale? People were bidding on them left and right! My goodness, those final numbers... Far too high for my pocket book.

402020303.text: *sigh*... This was not how it was meant to go. Where did those two come from?

402020304.text: Whatever your employer is offering you... The Maison Gardiennage will double it.

402020306.text: ...Ahem, I don't know what you're talking about.

402020307.text: Is that so? Well, you might be interested to know that this hit man over here is also on a need-to-know basis.

402020308.text: "If the person wearing the blue pin loses their bid, find somewhere secluded and eliminate them." All he can do is follow orders, I suppose...

402020310.text: You lucked out, kid! Getting cornered by the law just saved your life!

402020311.text: No no no no no, this can't be happening...

402020312.text: The boss said that even if I got sent to the Fortress of Meropide, all I had to do was keep my mouth shut, and he would find a way to get me out...

402020313.text: And he even paid me three million in advance! On that alone, I could get my wife the best medicine, help her hang on for a few more years...

402020314.text: But then, one auction goes wrong... Just one! And what? He's afraid I'm gonna talk? So now, I'm just collateral damage?

402020315.text: You're risking your life to do this guy's dirty work and pad his pockets with even more cash... Compared to what he's making, what you get in return are nothing but the scraps.

402020316.text: I've got at least seventy people just like you locked up in the Maison Gardiennage. Need them to tell you where this ends?

402020319.text: I'm guessing... You're offering me a way out. What do you need me to do, officer?

402020320.text: All you need to do is arrange a meeting with your boss and have a little chat.

402020321.text: My boss... He's extremely careful about that kind of thing. I've only met him three times — to pick up the advance, to go over the plan, and to get the funds for the auction.

402020322.text: The best I can do is take you to the place I'm supposed to deliver the goods. There's a certain method I can use to get in contact with him in case of emergencies.

402020323.text: Alright then. But first, we need to search your home for evidence related to the case.

402020325.text: You managed to get through to him so fast, Yelan! Paimon almost couldn't believe it!

402020326.text: Well, he was already nervous and uncertain... All it took was a sincere negotiation. Once I laid his interests out on the table, it didn't take much for him to realize he stands to gain more with us than his boss.

402020327.text: Plus, we had some very convincing performances to help seal the deal. Especially you, officer. You make an excellent hit man.

402020328.text: Ah, well. It's been a while since I've gotten to tap into a villain like that. Thought I could've pushed it a little more, honestly.

402020329.text: Are you kidding? Paimon felt like she was face to face with one of our bad guys of the week!

402020332.text: Well, what's next, Yelan? Want me to go after Corder or Doddamani?

402020333.text: The Sumeru authorities have Doddamani covered. They're just waiting on our signal, and they'll nab him once he makes it back to Bayda Harbor.

402020334.text: The Millelith are pursuing Scamface, so that just leaves Corder. Tail him, but be sure to keep your distance. We don't want him to tip anyone off.

402020335.text: You got it! I love it when a plan comes together like this.

402020336.text: Alright then, we'll reconvene twelve hours from now, when our new double agent will lead us into the lion's den...

402020337.text: It's time for the Dark Financier to face the music.

402020801.text: Good evening, patrons. Allow me to escort you to the auction.

402020601.text: (Hm, he's acting strange, and there's something off with his attire. No mistake — that's our guy.)

402020602.text: (His tea afficionado pin is a special color... most likely to make it easier for Corder to keep tabs on him and the situation as a whole.)

402020603.text: (Which means, the two don't know each other well at all... That's something we can use to our advantage...)

402020604.text: Once the auction is over, you all meet up outside the Hotel Debord. Officer Edler arrives with your new double agent in tow...

402020605.text: After checking the list of auction participants, you're able to confirm his identity. He turns out to be an ordinary clerk who ran into some financial trouble. Perhaps desperation was what drove him to take such a risk.

402021401.text: No time to waste. I'm ready!

402021402.text: Alright, then let's see those detective skills in action.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the goods delivery point

402020501.text: Alright, this is where the boss told me to bring the goods.

402020502.text: This area is full of apartments and warehouses for rent. The Maison Gardiennage came through not too long ago to keep trouble off the streets. I guess boss thinks it's safer to operate right under their noses...

402020503.text: Now, to arrange an emergency meeting, we need to activate a series of mechanisms to send him a signal.

402020504.text: But to tell you the truth, I have no idea how to activate them. The only hint boss gave was that the code has something to do with colors.

402020505.text: Maybe he was planning to give me more information after the auction, but that plan fell through, obviously...

402020506.text: Paimon was hoping it would be smooth sailing at this point! But no, of course, there's yet another obstacle...

402020507.text: Well, after all the investigating it took us to get this far, figuring out what to do with these mechanisms should be a piece of cake!

subQuests.subQuestName: Equip the item and talk to Yelan
Wait for the target to arrive

402020701.text: Unbelievable... You've bested me, fair and square.

402020703.text: Ah, perhaps a bit too dramatic, isn't it? I'd rather not give a soapbox to a piece of scum like you.

402020704.text: No, I think I'll say my piece instead...

402020705.text: You can pretend to have "seen the error of your ways," but it doesn't matter — because you're going to rot in prison for the rest of your life, and every moment of every day, you'll be cursing the greed that put you there.

402020706.text: Every coin of dirty money that you've pocketed over the years is just another nail in your coffin.

402020707.text: And all you'll be able to do is curl up in the corner of your cell like a dying animal, and waste away whatever remains of your pathetic life.

402020708.text: You're not a detective... No. You're some kind of demon!

402020709.text: If you knew what's good for you, you'd have walked away from this fight! But it's too late for that now.

402020710.text: Phew... After six months of hard work, I finally get to tick off the "mission accomplished" box at the end of the case file.

402020711.text: Take this guy back to the Court of Fontaine to stand trial. Don't let him try anything.

402020712.text: With any luck, we'll get to send him off to prison before the day is out.

402020714.text: ...As a personal thanks for all your help, you deserve half of the bonus I'm getting for this case! I will also request that the Maison Gardiennage extend our utmost thanks to our partners in Liyue.

402020715.text: I appreciate the sentiment, Officer Edler, but that's too kind.

402020716.text: I was just doing my job. I can't, in good conscience, accept even a single Mora. I'll have to pass up any invitations for banquets or tea-tastings as well.

402020717.text: #If you want to reward someone for going above and beyond during this operation, it should be {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

402020721.text: Paimon's had her detective cap on for so long, analyzing all those clues and trying to uncover their schemes, that her brain hurts! But, at the same time, she feels smarter than before!

402020722.text: Maybe Paimon really does have what it takes to be a real detective!

402020723.text: Well, if you're interested in this line of work, we're heading to the Maison Gardiennage to get a confession out of these guys. Did you want to tag along?

402020724.text: Y—You really mean it? Yes! One hundred percent yes!

402020725.text: #Is that okay, {NICKNAME}? Paimon's gonna go with Officer Edler and learn some cool new detective skills! Who knows, maybe they'll come in handy someday?

402021101.text: Time to equip the <color=#00E1FFFF>Forensic Imaging Device</color> and take stock of the clues in this area.

402021201.text: If all goes to plan, this should be the last phase of the investigation. It's a shame, I know... But all good things must come to an end.

402021301.text: Let me just check I'm prepared.

402021501.text: (I still need to equip the <color=#00E1FFFF>Forensic Imaging Device</color> and record all the crucial pieces of evidence...)

402022101.text: Detective, I wanted to ask... Since I've cooperated with the investigation and all, do you think I'll get a lighter sentence?

402022102.text: That's for the Maison Gardiennage and the court to decide... But, I think your attitude will work in your favor.

402022103.text: Phew... I'm glad I came to my senses when I did. Otherwise, I'd be done for, for sure...

402029801.text: You follow the attendant to the auction site...

402029802.text: You begin your investigation at the meeting site marked by the scapegoat...

402029901.text: Alright, time to meet back up with Yelan. Our destination? A very important auction at the Hotel Debord!

402029902.text: This is our chance to catch the culprit behind this whole scheme!

402029903.text: Most of the items at this auction originate from Chenyu Vale...

402029904.text: This hundred-year-old porcelain is simply exquisite...

402029905.text: The starting price is 15,000,000 Mora. Don't miss this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity...

402029907.text: Huh? Paimon guesses we're not messing around then...

402029911.text: What!? Don't you think you're raising a little too fast?

402029912.text: Wow! That's a very generous bid!

402029913.text: I have 18,000,000 in the room. Do I have any more bids?

402029918.text: It looks like we've really stirred things up!

402029919.text: So this is how it's done...

402029920.text: Time to take some lessons from Paimon!

402029924.text: They don't put amateurs on the front row... Those guys don't mess around!

402029925.text: Wow, wow, wow! Our golden-haired guest here is really something else!

402029928.text: I wasn't expecting things to be this intense...

402029929.text: It looks like I'm going to have to take this auction seriously!

402029930.text: I guess this isn't the end of the world...

402029931.text: But I can't miss out on the next item.
